checks.name: Offline local-file boot has no generic source/scope inputs and six physical softkeys
Manual High-Z sequence exposes both menu levels and commits only on Enter
Shared numeric keys enter frequency, amplitude and offset without changing waveform
Digit cursor plus knob edits a selected decade; keyboard numeric entry commits once
Undo and redo restore committed generator values; editing keys do not pollute history
Scope has independent channel scale, position, horizontal position and trigger knobs
Cursors > X1/X2 > Entry knob measures Lab 7 delay and phase
Entry push selects a context-menu choice and channel softkeys affect the trace
Meas softkeys select, add and clear actual nodal measurements
Single remains armed without a trigger and freezes after a valid edge
Probe Comp is wired through real patch terminals and reads 1 kHz / 3 Vpp
3D uses the live panels, keeps camera return and displays both trace colors
Mobile panels fit and every softkey and knob remains reachable
No exceptions, rejected promises, failed assets or external requests
